academic.title: Reading Section, Module 2
passage_lines: Downtown Books, a family-owned bookstore operating for 15 years, recently added a café area and expanded its evening hours to accommodate working customers.
Owner Janet Miller explains, “We noticed many people wanted to browse books after
work but couldn’t make it during our traditional hours.”
The store now stays open until 9 P.M. on weekdays and offers coffee, pastries, and light
meals alongside its selection of books, magazines, and gifts. The café area includes
comfortable seating and free Wi-Fi for customers who want to read or work.
academic.passage: Reading Section, Module 2 Read an article. Downtown Books, a family-owned bookstore operating for 15 years, recently added a café area and expanded its evening hours to accommodate working customers. Owner Janet Miller explains, “We noticed many people wanted to browse books after work but couldn’t make it during our traditional hours.” The store now stays open until 9 P.M. on weekdays and offers coffee, pastries, and light meals alongside its selection of books, magazines, and gifts. The café area includes comfortable seating and free Wi-Fi for customers who want to read or work.

questions.answer: To serve customers who work during traditional business hours
